source.selection: U.S. cross-industry ownership 1235 detailed occupations with numeric positive employment, annual mean and annual median; exclude all aggregate hierarchy rows and suppressed wages.
source.expansion: Partition employment counts into synthetic shards; preserve source occupation counts and count-times-wage masses.
source.median_definition: Employment-weighted average of occupation medians; a proxy, never the national worker median.
source.payroll_definition: Employment times published annual mean wage; illustrative estimated wage mass, not observed payroll.
source.industries: No industry detail in national cross-industry source; segments are explicitly synthetic.
